name: Marivane
tagline: The operating system for the modern working waterfront.
positioning: Marivane unifies berth allocation, fuel, utilities metering, and compliance into one command layer for enterprise marina operators.

hero.h1: Command every slip, meter, and manifest from one deck.
hero.sub: Marivane replaces the clipboard and the spreadsheet with a single operating layer for berthing, fuel dispensing, utilities billing, and harbor compliance across your entire portfolio.

features.title: Dynamic berth allocation
features.description: Assign, reroute, and price slips in real time as vessels arrive. Marivane reads draft, beam, and LOA against your live bathymetry to prevent grounding disputes.

features.title: Metered fuel and utilities
features.description: Every dockside pump, shore-power pedestal, and water spigot streams usage to a single ledger, so a 42-foot transient's power draw bills itself before departure.

features.title: Harbor compliance ledger
features.description: Auto-generate spill logs, hazmat manifests, and Coast Guard inspection records from the same events your staff already log at the fuel dock.

features.title: Portfolio command view
features.description: Roll up occupancy, revenue-per-linear-foot, and dwell time across every marina you operate, from a single estuary to forty-one basins.

features.title: Transient reservation engine
features.description: Publish live availability to booking channels and hold slips with deposit capture, ending the radio-call scramble every summer weekend.

features.title: Storm and haul-out planning
features.description: Sequence haul-outs by tide window and yard capacity, then notify berth holders automatically when a named storm enters your forecast cone.

testimonials.quote: We manage 2,400 slips across the Gulf Coast. Marivane collapsed our fuel reconciliation from a three-day month-end ritual into a number I trust by Tuesday morning.
testimonials.name: Dana Kolstad

testimonials.quote: The berth engine caught a beam conflict our dockmaster would have waved through. That single prevented grounding paid for the platform for the year.
testimonials.name: Marcus Feld

testimonials.quote: Compliance used to live in a filing cabinet nobody opened until an inspector arrived. Now our spill and hazmat logs generate themselves off the fuel dock.
testimonials.name: Priya Ansel
